chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Hammond, the first national tour and the Grand Terrace
summary: Kuehl reads that Hammond started the first tour through Chicago's Grand Terrace and Buffalo; Basie thinks the Vendome Hotel detail is mixed up.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: All right, let's see. "John Hammond heard the band and initiated their first national tour." Did he initiate your national tour or did he bring you to New York? Were they the same thing?
Did you tour between Kansas City to New York or did you simply bus in?
I see. "The band left Kansas City, took up a short residency at the Grand Terrace in Chicago. Played at Vendome (PHONETIC) Hotel, Buffalo, then into Roseland --
I don't get that. I know we stayed there. I don't know where we could have played there. I don't know where we could have played there.
You mean there was no place to play?
I don't think so. I think maybe that's --
I think maybe -- there's a possibility he's sort of mixed up (inaudible) I know the band stayed there.
All right, now where is that other thing?
